title: check.py validates the kb path:line citations in _tools comments, so a fact inserted above them cannot shift them silently
goal: A kb/public/<path>:<line> citation in a _tools/*.py comment points at a fact line that still holds what the citation needs (at least the model or term named beside it), and check.py or a test reports one that does not; in SP-7y6dk257 one new fact at ci-and-headless.md:87 shifted five PRICE citations in bench_core.py and nothing reported it. Retrospective of SP-7y6dk257.
notes: Planned at the 2026-10-10 whole-backlog triage, which the operator asked to end with every draft planned into a sprint or dropped (sprint 2 of 13, "Fitness 2: pack ranking and pool eval correctness"); it blocks no fitness test and no real user reported it, so it sits in a late sprint of the sequence.
